newsitem.title: UK: Japanese shares lower in subdued London trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese shares lower in subdued London trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks dipped slightly on Friday in London, with activity dampened by Thursday's Thanksgiving holiday and Friday's abbreviated trading session on Wall Street.
The Nikkei 50 index of leading Japanese shares in London was down 3.40 points at 1476.41 at 1435 GMT, after the benchmark Nikkei 225 dropped 15.18 points to 21,020.36 in Tokyo amid profit-taking.

"The market has moved very slightly. There's nothing of any substance happening, and the Thanksgiving holiday in the States has made everything very, very quiet," one trader at a Japanese brokerage said.
He said the volume of trading was also exceptionally low.
Construction company Taisei hit a new year low in Tokyo, closing at 633 yen, but was trading at 639 yen in London. Toyota, which closed at 3110 yen in Tokyo, was trading lower in London at 3105 yen.
